title: Filtering the products table by numbers · part 19

steps.title: Count rows supplier_id > 7
steps.prompt: COUNT(*) counts how many rows survive the filter.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT count(*) FROM products WHERE supplier_id > 7;
hints: Write: SELECT count(*) FROM products WHERE supplier_id > 7;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM products WHERE supplier_id > 7;
steps.memory_trick: count(*) + WHERE = 'how many pass?'

steps.title: Filter then sort: supplier_id > 7
steps.prompt:
Filter first, then ORDER BY tidies what is left.
LIMIT 3 keeps the top of that sorted list.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM products WHERE supplier_id > 7 ORDER BY supplier_id LIMIT 3;
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM products.
Write: SELECT id FROM products WHERE supplier_id > 7 ORDER BY supplier_id LIMIT 3;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM products WHERE supplier_id > 7 ORDER BY supplier_id LIMIT 3;
steps.memory_trick: WHERE trims, ORDER BY sorts, LIMIT cuts.
